binaryProbe.scope: Version/help only, never a real-editor tracing pass

requiredEditorEvidence: Actual native Copilot Agent Host and legacy Local qualified independently
Approved cloud GUI host and authorized account or proven loopback-only editor model route
Credentials stay in the protected shared store; absent from synced editor settings, argv and tool processes
Daemon-free lifecycle with safe bounded export and immediate persisted kill switch
Full GUI restart without shell environment; reload cannot be assumed to restart shared Agent Host
Resolved managed policy and exact settings provenance inside the selected harness
Two workspaces with distinct project routing and no CLI-plus-editor duplicate spans
Actual prompt/model/tool spans, conversation grouping, privacy/identity filtering and usage ownership
Final turn flush and exporter failures do not block the editor
Real Future AGI trace-view screenshots or GIFs, not CLI substitutes
constraints: No managed worker, collector, normalizer daemon or unnecessary marketplace extension
Newer legacy extension sources expose github.copilot.chat.otel.headers; it is intentionally never used to persist credentials
Environment-only direct export cannot establish GUI credential safety or privacy
File exporters persist sensitive content and require a separate reviewed lifecycle; no raw transcript or JSONL persistence added
No customer install guide or package publication until the real editor gate clears
